status: proposed semantics; the companion oracle is independent of explorEDA and does not test an implemented feature
notes: All expected memberships, row IDs, counts, and rational metric pairs were authored explicitly; the oracle derives actual outputs independently.
Raw scalar equality preserves type. Empty, whitespace-only, null, undefined, and nonfinite components are invalid. Nonblank whitespace remains significant.
Expected keys group duplicate declarations into one obligation. Duplicate/repeated flags overlap presence memberships.

Global observationPolicy applies only to required keys. Keyed exclusions require a reason and apply only to declared expected keys; valid unused entries are warnings and cannot suppress actual-only keys.
Dense bounded schedule candidates are a chosen product proposal: non-due weekdays and exact skips are excluded keys, never inferred from actual observations.
Fixture IDs are human labels. Per-input row IDs are stable test occurrence IDs, not claims that baseline positional source references survive refresh.
Metric fractions are exact. available=false for zero denominator. JSON fixture output order is not a public ordering guarantee.
The runtime-only codec vectors use out-of-band hydrate metadata; user row objects never act as magic sentinels.

fixtures.description: Composite keys; zero and null measurements still present; duplicate flags overlap memberships; absent, unexpected, exclusions and invalids.
Numeric, text and Boolean keys remain distinct; nonblank whitespace is preserved.
Ordered typed tuples resist delimiter and type collisions.
Global min2/max3 distinguishes presence, minimum attainment and legitimate repeated observations.
An unbounded maximum allows several observations at one expectation.
No required keys gives an unavailable percentage, not a perfect score.
A successfully loaded empty actual table makes each required key absent.
An unavailable source cannot support any absence claim.
The saved actual population is value > 0; expectations remain unchanged. This is not a display filter.
Adding a matching B27 observation changes the prior absent key to matched, preserving its matching key.
Equivalent explicit-offset instants match; naive, invalid, and unsupported submillisecond inputs do not.
An explicit candidate table retaining planned skips and non-due weekdays.
A bounded declared roster plus daily candidates and weekday/skip eligibility matches F12 exactly apart from expected provenance.
A valid unused exclusion is a warning; it cannot suppress an actual-only key.
Known partial reads block absence claims even when some actual rows are available.
